branding.title: Branding & appearance
branding.subtitle: Upload {{org}}'s logo and Dinequora suggests an accessible light and dark theme. Branding is cosmetic only and never changes access permissions.

logo.title: Logo
logo.subtitle: Drag a file here or choose one to upload.
logo.formats: PNG, JPEG, SVG or WebP · up to 2 MB
logo.fallback: Without a logo, the workspace shows the organization's initials and the default theme.
logo.ownerOnly: Only owners can change branding. You can view it here.

palette.title: Brand colors
palette.subtitleEmpty: Generate from your logo or enter HEX values.

errors.noColors: We couldn't find distinct brand colors in this logo. Enter colors manually.
errors.readFailed: This image couldn't be analyzed. Try another file.
errors.type: Unsupported file type. Use PNG, JPEG, SVG or WebP.
errors.size: This file is larger than 2 MB.
errors.saveFailed: Your theme could not be saved. Only an owner can change branding in an active workspace.

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Subscription and billing for {{org}}.
billing.notConnected: Online payments aren't connected yet, so no card is charged here. For now, billing is handled by the Dinequora team.
billing.plansNote: A monthly subscription per plan, with a location limit, plus a one-time implementation fee. Semiannual (8% off) and annual (15% off) are paid upfront; the implementation fee is never discounted.
billing.ownerOnlyBody: Billing is visible only to organization owners.
billing.billedPendingSync: {{count}} — not synced yet: online payments aren’t connected
billing.previewManaged: During the preview, billing for this workspace is arranged directly with your Dinequora contact. No card is stored or charged here.
billing.testMode: Test mode: payments go through Stripe's test environment and no real card is charged.
billing.manageNote: Change your card, download invoices or cancel in Stripe's secure portal.
billing.checkoutReturned: Thanks! Stripe is confirming your payment. Your subscription updates here in a few seconds.
billing.checkoutCanceled: Checkout was canceled. Nothing was charged.

checkoutErrors.not_configured: Online payments aren't available yet. Contact the Dinequora team.
checkoutErrors.already_subscribed: You already have a subscription. Use Manage subscription to change it.
checkoutErrors.plan_unavailable: This plan can't be bought online. Contact the Dinequora team.
checkoutErrors.no_customer: There's no online subscription to manage yet.
checkoutErrors.unavailable: Couldn't reach the payment service. Try again in a moment.

change.title: Switch to {{plan}} · {{period}}
change.chargedNow: The new plan starts today and the subscription's card is charged now.
change.laterBody: The change takes effect on {{date}}, at the end of the period already paid. Until then you keep your current plan. Nothing is charged now and the paid period is not refunded.
change.done: Plan changed. It may take a few seconds to show here.
change.scheduled: Change scheduled for the end of the paid period.

changeErrors.contact_support: To move to a bigger plan with a shorter period at the same time, contact support.
changeErrors.plan_unavailable: This plan or period is not available online right now.
changeErrors.too_many_locations: You have more active locations than this plan allows. Deactivate some first.
changeErrors.fix_payment_first: Update your card in Manage subscription first: the last payment failed.
changeErrors.payment_failed: The card was declined. Nothing was changed.
changeErrors.no_subscription: There is no active subscription to change.
changeErrors.not_configured: Online payments are not connected yet.
changeErrors.unavailable: The change could not be made right now. Try again in a moment.

security.title: Security
security.description: Protect your account with a second step at sign-in.
security.statusOn: On: each sign-in also asks for a code from your app.
security.statusOff: Off: only your password protects this account.
security.mfaBody: Use an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…). After your password, Dinequora will ask for the 6-digit code the app shows.
security.setupBody: Scan the QR code with the app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
security.qrAlt: QR code to link the authenticator app
security.secretHint: Can't scan? Type this key in the app:
security.removeBody: Sign-ins will ask only for your password. You can link an app again at any time.

errors.format: Enter the 6 digits shown in your app.
errors.invalid: That code is not valid or has expired. Try the current one.
errors.reauth: For your safety, sign in again with your code and then try once more.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
